$comment: MOBI / KF8 export and import (feature 018): File > Export > Export as MOBI..., File > Import > MOBI File..., File > Open's refusal of a MOBI, the export's Save dialog and fallback options window, Settings > Exports > MOBI, archive/FBD prompts, refusals, progress, and summaries. Feature catalogue merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

exportMobi.description: Write the book as an unencrypted MOBI 7, joint MOBI 7 + KF8, or KF8 (AZW3) e-book with cover thumbnail, native navigation, notes, and optional ZIP + FBD archive

importMobi.description: Make a new book from an unencrypted MOBI, AZW3, AZW, or PRC file (or a ZIP archive holding one); the editor's own exports round-trip whole

mobi.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
mobi.exportCancelled: The MOBI export was cancelled; no file was written.
mobi.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

exportSummary.pictureConverted: Picture converted to JPEG or PNG: {{detail}}
exportSummary.pictureDownscaled: Picture downscaled to stay under 10 MB: {{detail}}
exportSummary.gapFilled: Filled in the exported file only: {{detail}}
exportSummary.idMadeUnique: Duplicate id made unique in the exported file: {{detail}}
exportSummary.mfbeSkipped: Embedded round-trip record omitted: metadata exceeded the 48 KB header budget

gap.title: the book's title
gap.language: the book's language (English used for added labels)

writeFailed.targetIsSource: it is the book's own file, or the archive it was opened from.
writeFailed.checkFailed: the finished file failed its own check ({{detail}}).
writeFailed.ioError: the file could not be written ({{detail}}).
writeFailed.badPart: a required part of the book was missing.
writeFailed.unknownToken: the export session was no longer known to the core.

mobi.openRefused: {{path}} is a MOBI e-book. File > Open takes FictionBook (FB2) books, FBD files and ZIP archives holding FB2 books; a MOBI book is imported with File > Import > MOBI File....
mobi.openRefusedInArchive: {{path}} holds a MOBI e-book but no FictionBook book. A MOBI book is imported with File > Import > MOBI File....
mobi.importDone: Imported from MOBI: {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
mobi.importCancelled: The MOBI import was cancelled; the book in the window is unchanged.
mobi.importSummaryIntro: Not everything came over as written:

importSummary.fallbackMobi7: The KF8 part of the joint file was damaged; imported the MOBI 7 part instead.
importSummary.mfbeExternallyModified: The file was modified outside the editor; edited parts were imported from the MOBI content.
importSummary.mfbeCorrupt: The editor's embedded round-trip record could not be read; imported as a regular MOBI book.
importSummary.pictureConverted: Picture converted to JPEG or PNG: {{detail}}
importSummary.pictureTooLarge: Picture larger than 100 megapixels, not added: {{detail}}
importSummary.linkAsText: Link to a missing target, written as text: {{detail}}
importSummary.dropped: Left out (FB2 has no place for it): {{detail}}
importSummary.cssDropped: Style not supported by FB2 stylesheets, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.formulaAsText: Formula could not be rasterised, kept as text: {{detail}}
importSummary.drawingLeftOut: Drawing could not be rasterised, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.nestingFlattened: Nesting deeper than {{detail}} levels, flattened into paragraphs
importSummary.droppedScripts: Scripts, left out and never run: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedMedia: Audio, video, or embedded objects, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedChar: Unsupported private-use or control characters, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.mended: Adjusted to keep the imported FB2 valid: {{detail}}
importSummary.fbd: The description, cover included, was taken from {{name}}.

refused.notMobi: it is not a MOBI, KF8, or PalmDOC book.
refused.encrypted: the book is encrypted or DRM-protected and cannot be imported.
refused.kfx: Amazon KFX files are not supported.
refused.tooLarge: the file is larger than 150 MB.
refused.tooManyRecords: the file holds too many PalmDB records.
refused.decompressBomb: the compressed text expands past safe limits and was refused.
refused.damaged: the file is damaged and could not be read.
refused.fictionBook: it is a FictionBook file — open it with File > Open.
refused.noMobiInArchive: the archive holds no MOBI, AZW3, AZW, or PRC file.
refused.encryptedArchive: the archive is protected by a password.
refused.method: the archive uses a compression method the editor does not read.
refused.multiVolume: the archive is one volume of a multi-part archive.
refused.missing: the chosen file is no longer in the archive.

fbd.whichBook: The archive holds several MOBI books. Choose one to import:
fbd.whichFbd: The archive holds FBD description files. Choose one to apply, or None:
fbd.whichDescription: {{mobi}} carries its book's description, and {{fbd}} holds another one. Which description should the book take?
fbd.none: None — keep the MOBI's own description
fbd.unreadable: {{name}} could not be read ({{reason}}); the book comes in without it.

settings.kf8PopupFootnotesHint: Works on modern Kindles (KF8 and joint files); older MOBI 7 readers always jump to the end.

mobi.format: MOBI 7 + KF8 works on both old and modern readers; MOBI 7 is for older devices; KF8 (.azw3) is for modern Kindles
mobi.zip: Pack the exported book and its FBD description together in a ZIP archive

mobi.format: File format selected by default: MOBI 7 + KF8 works on both old and modern readers
mobi.tocPlacement: Where to put a table of contents page inside the book (the reader's own menu is always included)
mobi.seriesInTitle: Adds the book's series name or number to the title shown in your reader's library list (the title page stays unchanged)
mobi.openAt: Which page the reader shows when opening the book for the first time
mobi.kf8PopupFootnotes: Show footnotes in a pop-up on modern Kindles (older MOBI 7 readers jump to the end of the book)
mobi.zip: Pack the exported book and its FBD description together in a ZIP archive by default
